description: Surface merge-watch gh poll failures: discriminated GhPollFn result, persisted consecutive-error counter, edge-triggered merge-watch-poll-error event at threshold N

officialDocsConsulted.summary: Confirmed gh pr view supports --json field output used by the production poll wrapper. Error/exit-code detail lives in gh help exit-codes; gh exits non-zero on failure and writes the error message to stderr, which is what the error result must surface.

userStories.title: Add merge-watch-poll-error event vocabulary and consecutiveNullPolls state persistence
userStories.description: As a cam operator, I need the merge-watch event vocabulary and durable state to carry a consecutive-poll-error counter and a poll-error event kind, so that a later tick can persist poll failures across sidecar restarts and report them in the structured event log.
acceptanceCriteria: A new 'merge-watch-poll-error' kind is added to the WorkerEventKind union in src/supervisor/events.ts, with a MergeWatchPollErrorEventDetail interface carrying prNumber (number), the consecutive count (number), and the last gh stderr (string), added to the WorkerEventDetail union with a doc comment referencing CAM-170. [oracle: grep -q 'merge-watch-poll-error' src/supervisor/events.ts && grep -q 'MergeWatchPollErrorEventDetail' src/supervisor/events.ts]

MergeWatchState (src/release/merge-watch.ts) gains an optional consecutiveNullPolls field; readMergeWatchState parses it when present as a number (absent = fresh, no migration, mirroring pollCount); writeMergeWatchState always writes it, defaulting to 0 when absent. [oracle: grep -q 'consecutiveNullPolls' src/release/merge-watch.ts]

A round-trip test proves persistence: writeMergeWatchState with consecutiveNullPolls set reads back the same value via readMergeWatchState; a legacy state file without the field reads back with the field absent and is treated as fresh. [oracle: bun test test/release/merge-watch.test.ts]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Full quality spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Files: src/supervisor/events.ts (WorkerEventKind union at ~line 99, WorkerEventDetail union at ~line 389, detail interfaces near MergeWatchStalledEventDetail at ~line 256), src/release/merge-watch.ts (MergeWatchState interface ~line 295, readMergeWatchState ~line 79, writeMergeWatchState ~line 120), test/release/merge-watch.test.ts. This story is purely additive: no behavior change, no GhPollFn signature change (that is US-002). Spec keeps the legacy name consecutiveNullPolls even though US-002 will count discriminated error results; follow the spec verbatim. Mirror the pollCount persistence convention exactly: always written (default 0), optional on the interface, legacy read treated as fresh. Doc reference: docs/recovery-runbook.md section (t) lists the merge-watch event kinds; re-check it before coding.

userStories.title: Discriminated GhPollFn result and edge-triggered poll-error emit in stepMergeWatch
userStories.description: As a cam operator, I need merge-watch to count consecutive gh poll failures and, when they cross a threshold N, emit one merge-watch-poll-error event and one orchestrator narration carrying the gh stderr, so that a revoked or stale GITHUB_TOKEN is loud and diagnosable mid-watch instead of spinning mute to the 4h timeout.
acceptanceCriteria: GhPollFn (src/release/merge-watch.ts) returns a discriminated result: a PrStatus on success or an error result carrying the gh stderr string (no more bare null). A normal poll of a still-open PR returns a PrStatus (state OPEN) and does not count as an error; a pure stepMergeWatch tick test proves a successful not-merged poll never increments the counter. [oracle: bun test test/release/merge-watch.test.ts]
A named exported threshold constant with default value 3 exists in src/release/merge-watch.ts (three minutes at the 60s interval). [oracle: grep -qE 'POLL_ERROR.*= 3' src/release/merge-watch.ts]

stepMergeWatch increments consecutiveNullPolls on each poll error and resets it to 0 on any successful poll, threading the counter through MergeWatchState (pure function: no FS, no Date.now; the caller persists via writeMergeWatchState). A pure tick test proves the increment and the reset. [oracle: bun test test/release/merge-watch.test.ts]

When the counter transitions to exactly N, stepMergeWatch emits exactly one merge-watch-poll-error event via the logEvent seam and notifyOrchestrator narrates exactly once; ticks at N+1 and N+2 emit nothing; a successful poll resets the counter and a later re-crossing to N emits again. Tests count both logEvent calls and notifyOrchestrator calls. [oracle: bun test test/release/merge-watch.test.ts]
The merge-watch-poll-error event detail carries prNumber, the consecutive count, and the last gh stderr. [oracle: bun test test/release/merge-watch.test.ts]

Reaching or exceeding the threshold does not change the watch outcome: a test proves polling continues past N to the existing maxPolls timeout terminal, and a fail-then-recover sequence proceeds to MERGED normally. [oracle: bun test test/release/merge-watch.test.ts]

A run that fails consecutively past N and then recovers emits merge-watch-poll-error but never merge-watch-stalled (mid-watch advisory vs terminal are distinct). [oracle: bun test test/release/merge-watch.test.ts]

The production ghPollFn wrapper in src/commands/sidecar.ts surfaces gh stderr (spawnSync result.stderr) into the error result on non-zero exit and on JSON-parse failure; the GhPollFn signature change is propagated to every test fake (makeSeqPollFn and all inline pollFns) and the whole suite is green. [oracle: bun test]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Full quality spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Files: src/release/merge-watch.ts (GhPollFn type ~line 371, stepMergeWatch ~line 761: the status === null continue branch at ~line 805 becomes the error branch; runMergeWatch passes pollFn through unchanged), src/commands/sidecar.ts (production ghPollFn ~line 511: spawnSync with encoding utf8 already captures result.stderr; return the error result instead of null on non-zero status and on JSON-parse failure, synthesizing a message when stderr is empty), test/release/merge-watch.test.ts, test/supervisor/sidecar-loop.test.ts. Gotchas from spec: emit-once is a transition to exactly N (=== N after increment, never >= N); reset on ANY successful poll re-arms the emit; notifyOrchestrator narration gated to once per crossing, matching the single event emission; do NOT add any new terminal outcome (the 240-poll/4h cap remains the only cap; poll-error is advisory and out of scope of merge-watch-stalled which is CAM-182 and fires only on non-merged terminals). Project gotchas: test/release/merge-watch.test.ts ~line 2316 has a source-regex hygiene test matching the literal production signature 'const ghPollFn: GhPollFn = (prNumber): PrStatus | null =>'; it MUST be updated to match the new discriminated signature or it fails. makeSeqPollFn at merge-watch.test.ts:83 takes Array<PrStatus | null>; migrate its element type to the discriminated result. notifyOrchestrator coalesce invariant: exactly one send-keys line per crossing (back-to-back send-keys race in the orchestrator Ink prompt). Doc maintenance: docs/recovery-runbook.md section (t) lists merge-watch event kinds and describes the silent-retry-on-null behavior; update that list/behavior in the same commit.
